title: SHAP-Guided GA Population Seeding for Faster Convergence Below Brier 0.22
source: WebSearch: NBA prediction ML 2025-2026 MDPI/Nature/PMC literature

context.fleet_extra_trees_dominance: 4 of 6 islands best model is extra_trees
context.key_finding: SHAP analysis across NBA prediction papers consistently shows top 3 features: home_next (home advantage of next game), team_elo_5y (5-year ELO), team_elo (current ELO). These features are already in engine.py v3.0-43cat.

problem.description: Current GA starts with fully random feature subsets. Most individuals in generation 0 lack fundamental predictors (ELO, home advantage), wasting 10-20 generations on rediscovering basics. With 3,267 feature candidates, the probability of randomly picking all 3 key SHAP features in a 60-feature individual is very low.
problem.calculation: P(all 3 SHAP top features in random 60 of 3267) = C(3264,57)/C(3267,60) ≈ 0.001 per individual

proposal.technique: Biased initialization: seed 20% of initial population (12 of 60 individuals) with guaranteed inclusion of top-10 SHAP features

implementation.location: app.py init_population() function on each island
implementation.code_change: When creating individual, if random() < 0.20: force include SHAP_SEED_FEATURES before random selection of remaining features
implementation.rationale: These features appear in best-performing models: S14 extra_trees 59feat, S15 extra_trees 99feat. Confirmed by SHAP literature: ELO and home advantage = most predictive NBA features across all models.

expected_impact.brier_improvement: 0.001-0.003 improvement by gen 10 vs random init
expected_impact.risk: LOW — only 20% seeded, 80% still random (diversity preserved)

cross_repo_port.nba_to_political: Same technique applicable to PA4. Seed political GA with known-good features: donation_amount, donation_timing, sector_heat, policy_signal_count

references.title: Integration of machine learning XGBoost and SHAP models for NBA game outcome prediction
Stacked ensemble model for NBA game outcome prediction analysis
Uncertainty-Aware ML for NBA Forecasting in Digital Betting Markets
references.finding: XGBoost Brier 0.202, AUC 0.754 — best economic performance among tabular models

deployment_steps: 1. Identify feature name constants in engine.py for ELO/home features
2. Add SHAP_SEED_FEATURES list to app.py config section
3. Modify init_population(): for 20% of individuals, start feature set with seed features then fill to target_size randomly
4. Apply to S10 first (exploitation island), monitor Brier over 20 generations
5. If Brier improves by gen 20, deploy to all 6 islands
